text: The review questions repeated update events because their frequency would add timing information beyond the requested count of users with default versus modified settings. The accepted implementation sets a labeled Boolean on initialization and later URL preference changes. Its URL value is !prefHasUserValue, so it describes preference provenance rather than successful display or whether notifications are enabled. The module-level lazy getter is placed after the object following a reported temporal-dead-zone failure. This is the scoped notification metric design and historical rationale; no telemetry or module-load test ran here.
title: Notification preference telemetry uses state instead of a repeated fetch event
